planets.name: TOI-125 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-125 with a 20-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-125 d was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 3 planets known around TOI-125. Its orbit and size follow Nielsen et al. 2020's fit, the archive's default.
